Chapter 15: Looking Forward—Hope, Uncertainty, and the Work Ahead.
As another day draws to a close, the world feels both comfortingly familiar... and a little bit strange, doesn’t it? Those big forces—McWorld and Jihad—are still shaping our lives, sometimes in ways we notice right away, and sometimes in ways we can’t quite see.
The truth is, the challenges we’re facing? They’re real. And let’s be honest, the answers aren’t simple.
But you know what? There’s hope. All around us, people are looking for new ways to live together. They’re trying to find that sweet spot—balancing our need to belong, with the promise of being open to others. Building communities that are both strong and welcoming isn’t easy work. The road ahead is uncertain. But think about the alternative: a world full of lonely shoppers and angry, divided groups? That’s just too bleak to accept.
Picture this—a parent tucking her child into bed at night, wondering what kind of world her little one will grow up in. She understands that every choice we make today shapes tomorrow. And she hopes, deep down, that her child will live in a world where differences aren’t just tolerated but celebrated... where democracy is more than just a word, and everyone truly has a seat at the table.
The story of Jihad versus McWorld? It isn’t finished. In fact, it’s being written every single day—in homes, in classrooms, in communities just like yours. Our job is to keep writing that story: to imagine new possibilities, to build bridges where there are walls, and to keep the promise of democracy alive and real.
